verdict.rationale: Finix documents automated reporting that covers transactions and fees, plus Dashboard and API management of seller payouts and a platform Finix balance. That gives the product its own glancing support for financial legibility, but nothing shows a full ledger. Missing for 10: per-seller balance views, platform fee-account balances, end-to-end traceability from charge through split to payout, penny-level reconciliation tooling or settlement-matching docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, the platform's money is legible — balances by seller and by my own fee accounts, every movement traceable from charge through split to payout, reconcilable to the penny

citations.quote: From transactions to disputes and fees, more than 10 report types are automated and available in your personal dashboard
You can manage how sellers get paid out using the Finix Dashboard or our API.
Top up your Finix balance with ACH or wire transfers before sending payouts.
